title: Introducing Lívia Eduarda, our 'Supernova' issue cover star
excerpt: Our November model muse Lívia Eduarda steps into the spotlight as the cover star of our 'Supernova' issue in CHANEL.
content:
Some stars take their time to burn. Lívia Eduarda is just getting started. A Scorpio with a competitive streak and a contemplative mind, she finds as much exhilaration in movement as she does in the mysteries of the universe. There’s room in her world for CHANEL runways, Plato and Vivaldi, and a curiosity that refuses to settle on any one thing. Between London and the Brazilian coast, she’s learning that becoming yourself is its own kind of transformation. And the brightest things are only just beginning to come into view.

The first thing you should know about me is … I first tried modelling when I was 17 years old, but decided to step away to finish school, enjoy my teenage years and dedicate more time to volleyball and basketball. I came back this year, and I’m very glad I gave myself that time to grow.

I’m currently living in … London.

My favourite thing to do here is … Play sports outdoors and spend time with my best friend, who also lives here.

But if I could be anywhere, I’d be … Somewhere warm, by the sea, with the people I love.

My star sign is … Scorpio.

It suits me because … I’m quietly determined, very loyal, and when I care about something or someone, I give it my all.

My friends would describe me as … Calm and someone they can always count on.

I shine brightest when … I’m in action, whether I’m playing sports or working.

My go-to coffee order is … A cappuccino with soya milk and a sprinkle of cinnamon on top.

I like to start my day by … Taking a cold shower, doing my skincare routine and having my coffee.

And finish it with … Talking to my family back in Brazil.

I would describe my personal style as … Relaxed and understated. I prefer a more discreet look to anything overly styled.

Right now, the most prized piece in my wardrobe is … A pair of vintage black leather trousers.

Advice I don’t like to follow is … Other people’s opinions about who I should or shouldn’t date. I prefer to make up my own mind.

The biggest risk I’ve taken was … Driving from São Paulo back to my hometown just after getting my driver’s license. I got caught in a terrible storm, and the visibility was so bad I ended up driving at 40km/h almost the entire way.

Something I’m romanticising right now is … Getting to know more of Plato and other ancient Greek philosophers, especially what they had to say about love. It’s crazy how ideas from thousands of years ago are actually helping me a lot to manage my life today.

An album I’ve had on repeat is … Not exactly an album, but a playlist of classical music I’ve put together, mostly Beethoven and Vivaldi. I’ve been listening to it constantly lately.

A comfort film I love to rewatch is … Run Lola Run. I love the idea that one small decision can change everything.

If I could bottle one moment forever, it would be … I can’t decide between the first time I saw my little sister’s face and the last time I saw my Grandmother before she passed away. One was a beginning and the other a goodbye.

The brightest moment of my career so far has been … Walking for CHANEL for the very first time.

But a dream I’m still yet to realise is … To be photographed by Steven Meisel.

When I get a week off, I’m headed to … Somewhere warm, preferably with beautiful beaches and no alarm clock!

My universe is expanding towards … Exploring the unconscious through Carl Jung’s work and discovering more about myself. I’m fascinated by how much of who we are is actually beyond our conscious control.
